combinations.magnitude: Formoterol fully reversed mechanical hypersensitivity in control mice but not in Cx3cr1-Adrb2-/- mice, in both sexes
combinations.evidence_quote: In comparison to saline application, Formoterol application at days 6 or 21 post-SNI led to a significant decrease in neuropathic hypersensitivity to mechanical stimuli (Figure 6D,E) and cold stimuli (Figure 6F) in control mice, but not in Cx3cr1-Adrb2-/- mice (Figure 6D,F).

combinations.magnitude: analgesic effect of Formoterol on cold stimuli was lost in Cx3cr1-Adrb2-/- mice at day 6 and 21 post-SNI
combinations.evidence_quote: Indeed, the analgesic effect of Formoterol related to cold stimuli was lost in Cx3cr1-Adrb2-/- mice (Figure 6F).

combinations.readout: microglial density in ipsilateral spinal dorsal horn
combinations.magnitude: Formoterol failed to decrease microglial density in Cx3cr1-Adrb2-/- mice of both sexes at 6 and 21 days post-SNI
combinations.evidence_quote: Indeed, in contrast to control mice, Formoterol treatment failed to decrease the density of microglia in the ipsilateral SDH of Cx3cr1-Adrb2-/- mice of both sexes 6 and 21 days after SNI operation (Figure 7A,B), further supporting a role of β2-AR activation in the modulation of microglial reactivity and in the induction of neuropathic pain.

combinations.readout: microglial activity markers p-p38 and p-JNK
combinations.magnitude: Formoterol failed to damp upregulation of p-p38/p-JNK in microglia of Cx3cr1-Adrb2-/- mice of both sexes at 6 and 21 days post-SNI
combinations.evidence_quote: As expected, contrary to what happened in control mice, in both male and female Cx3cr1-Adrb2-/- mice Formoterol failed to damp the upregulation of microglial activity marker typically seen 6 and 21 days after SNI (Figure 8).
